ndr-space-cochin.summary: A Grade A warehousing park on the northern edge of Kochi, off SH-16 near Aluva. The site sits between Cochin International Airport and the Kochi port terminals, with the national highway and the Aluva metro and rail stations a short drive away, which suits distribution into Ernakulam and central Kerala.
